FAQ: What is the fair-value range for Emaar Development (EMAARDEV)? — testahil publishes a probability distribution of where Emaar Development could trade over the next 1–3 months — the simulated 5th–95th percentile range and the central 50% — together with a weighted central fair value, not a single price target or a buy/sell call. The full study and open model show the methodology. This is educational analysis, not investment advice.

How is the Emaar Development valuation calculated? — The study triangulates four lenses — an RNAV / split sum-of-the-parts (net cash plus the present value of the roughly AED 125bn sold backlog and a haircut land bank, with no terminal value on the finite build-to-sell development legs); a going-concern discounted cash flow on an exit-multiple terminal; a relative-multiples cross-check; and a property-cycle earnings view that replaces normalized earnings for a finite-life developer — then expresses the result as a 50,000-path Monte Carlo probability distribution.Over 30 resolved three-month forecasts, the price finished inside the 90% band 93% of the time, against the 90% that band aims at. The band is about as tight as a simple no-forecast rule would give (1.02x its width). Every assumption is visible and editable in the free Excel model.
